Application Data.NAME: ABC Mail & Pack Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Mail & Pack Services specializes in providing comprehensive mail and packaging solutions, including the rental of secured mailboxes for personal and business use. Our operations involve the storage and handling of various packages and documents, ensuring their safety and timely delivery. We implement strict protocols for package handling and customer service, focusing on minimizing risks associated with property damage and spoilage. Our team is trained to follow safety measures to maintain a secure environment for all stored items, while also ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
Losses incurred during the storage of goods in rented mailboxes:  
- Date: 02/15/2023 - Cause: Water damage from a leak in the storage area - Amount: $7,000.00 - Status: Closed.  
- Date: 03/30/2023 - Cause: Theft of packages due to inadequate security measures - Amount: $8,000.00 - Status: Pending investigation.  
Total losses amount to $15,000.00.
